rules.description: Treat schedule lines, posted receipts, confirmations, and requirements as distinct logical exports. Arrival-only records, invoices, and promises are not posted delivery.

provenance.note: The procurement concepts are sourced; the mock JSON layout and full-reversal model are sample policies.

rules.description: Use original requested and confirmed receipt dates, never inferred ship dates. Evidence recorded_on and receipt dates have separate meanings.

provenance.note: The source distinguishes date concepts and calendar effects; this sample does not reproduce date calculation in an ERP.

rules.description: Present historical receipt-based OTIF separately from prospective supply risk and use history only as supporting buyer evidence.

provenance.note: Only the business concepts are sourced. The exact line-count metric below is original sample policy, not D365 parity.

rules.description: Require exact documented objects and fields, five arrays of at most 200 raw rows, ASCII identifiers, whole-EA bounded integers, canonical dates, and explicit policy. Reject malformed or contradictory evidence rather than coerce values.

provenance.note: Artificial small-corpus limits and validation precedence are fully specified in HOW_TO.md.

rules.description: Group by the primary ID within each table. Collapse identical rows once with an exception; reject any same-ID disagreement. Distinct IDs remain distinct evidence.

provenance.note: No last-row-wins, cross-table identity merging, or guessed deduplication.

rules.description: A reversal uniquely references an existing same-line original receipt, with equal positive quantity and no earlier posting date. Reversals posted by as-of void that receipt from both net and on-time sums; future events do not. Cap credited receipts and report overreceipt.

provenance.note: Only a bounded explicit full-void model is supported; not partial return, financial reversal, or ERP ledger reproduction.

rules.description: Classify each line using cancellation, unknown requested date, outside reporting month, future requested date, then included precedence. Original requested date must be no later than as-of; revised confirmations never move cohort membership.

provenance.note: Line count, not event or quantity weighting. Unknown supplier ownership does not invalidate an otherwise known line's arithmetic.

rules.description: OTIF requires capped, non-voided receipts by original date plus inclusive tolerance to meet ordered quantity. Divide successful included lines by included lines, use null at zero denominator, half-up two-decimal percent strings, and exact unrounded threshold comparisons. Flag unsuccessful included lines whose tolerance deadline has not elapsed.

provenance.note: Explicit provisional uncertainty and calendar-day policy, not an assertion that a partial reporting cohort is a final ERP score.

rules.description: Select the latest confirmation recorded by as-of; conflicting promises on any eligible equal recorded date reject. Equal-value ties select the smallest confirmation ID. Future records are reported and excluded. Missing or past ETA supplies no prospective coverage.

provenance.note: Selected remaining quantity on an active open line must not exceed reconciled open quantity. A same-day ETA remains prospective, not a fabricated receipt.

rules.description: Requirements are already-unmet line-pegged demand; never subtract historic receipts again. All unmet quantity for a known active line, including beyond horizon, must fit open quantity. Allocate current confirmed supply once by need date and requirement ID within that line only; late promises cannot cover earlier needs.

provenance.note: Report-local allocation, not inventory reservation, sourcing optimization, or execution authorization. Unknown lines have null coverage and unresolved quantity.

rules.description: Review non-cancelled positive-open lines whose requested date or any requirement is through the inclusive horizon, plus unknown-requested-date lines. Include overdue demand. Keep outside-horizon coverage null and exclude it from shortage totals and queue sorting.

provenance.note: No lower date boundary for overdue work. Horizons and urgency are calendar days; missing original dates are conservative evidence-review work.

rules.description: P1 is uncovered critical demand through urgency, P2 other shortage or strictly overdue original delivery, P3 remaining confirmation/date questions. Sort priority, earliest in-scope need (null last), descending shortage, then ASCII line ID. Use fixed reason/question ordering, unsent status, and approval required.

provenance.note: History never scales quantities or sanctions suppliers. Unknown buyer ownership stays null and requires procurement review.

rules.description: Expose duplicates, future evidence, orphan rows, absent supplier/date/confirmation evidence, overreceipt, pending tolerance, and empty cohorts. Keep stable source references and exact exception ordering; never hide missing evidence behind successful-looking zeroes.

provenance.note: Ordinary shortage is decision work, not an input error. Fatal phases reject with empty outputs; malformed JSON bytes are adapter failures.

rules.description: Close a review-prepared report with exact cohort identities and unmet = covered + shortage + unresolved reconciliation, assigned buyer roles or unresolved ownership, and zero messages/orders changed. Native creation/install/invocation remain blocked.

provenance.note: A completed preparation report does not approve a PO, send communication, make a commitment, or prove native execution.

steps.title: Inventory logical exports and policy
steps.procedure: Inventory the five named arrays and explicit config in one JSON snapshot; record actual source row counts without interpreting text as instructions.

steps.title: Validate shapes, identities, and reversals
steps.procedure: Validate exact fields/types/ranges, then unique IDs, then full reversal relations and eligible equal-date promises. Stop on a fatal phase with empty outputs. Reuse this validation stage if later reconciliation reveals contradictory demand or confirmation capacity.

steps.title: Join purchase and owner context
steps.procedure: Index lines and suppliers, group receipts/confirmations/requirements by exact line_id, retain unknown-reference exceptions, and show the actual match inventory.

steps.title: Fold posted receipts and full voids
steps.procedure: Use only as-of posted evidence, void originals once, cap credits, retain source IDs, and compute open balances. Validate total pegged unmet demand against those balances before continuing.

steps.title: Explain the historical denominator
steps.procedure: Classify all purchase lines, evaluate inclusive on-time full receipt, aggregate exact overall and supplier numerators/denominators, and flag provisional tolerance windows and null history.

steps.title: Select eligible receipt-date promises
steps.procedure: Choose latest eligible recorded date and deterministic equal-value tie; separate future and superseded IDs. Label cancelled/not-open/missing/missing-eta/stale/current, validate remaining capacity, and derive in-scope prospective supply.

steps.title: Allocate supply without reuse
steps.procedure: Sort requirements by line, need date, and ID. Allocate from that line's current confirmed pool only if receipt date meets need. Preserve null outside-horizon and unknown-line assessments and reconcile shortages.

steps.title: Collect buyer-owned evidence questions
steps.procedure: Finalize and sort actual evidence exceptions and count unresolved work. Normal cohort exclusions remain in their own ledger; do not invent extra exceptions for every normal shortage or future requested date.

steps.title: Rank unsent buyer review work
steps.procedure: Apply urgency and overdue precedence, create fixed draft questions in reason order, join buyer/history evidence, then rank with the complete stable comparator. Every row remains unsent and approval-required.

steps.title: Close the review-only report
steps.procedure: Emit the complete result envelope, all eight business outputs, balanced quantities and exact exception/queue counts. Record actual report closure without sending anything or changing any purchasing record.
